title: Faster code
description:
| Function | Result | How |
|---|---|---|
| `popcount(x)` | how many 1 bits x has | the `popcnt` instruction |
| `parity(x)` | 1 if x has an odd number of 1 bits, else 0 | `popcnt`, then a mask |
| `sum_fast(array, n)` | the total of n signed 8-byte numbers, for any n >= 0 | **four** accumulators, four elements per round, then a loop for the 0 to 3 left over |
| `count_below(array, n, limit)` | how many elements are less than limit (signed) | no branch inside the loop: `setl` or `cmovl` and an add |

starter.solution.asm:
popcount:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

parity:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

sum_fast:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

count_below:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
popcount:
        popcnt  rax, rdi
        ret

parity:
        popcnt  rax, rdi
        and     eax, 1
        ret

sum_fast:
        xor     eax, eax
        xor     ecx, ecx
        xor     r8d, r8d
        xor     r9d, r9d
        mov     r10, rsi
        and     r10, -4                 ; the elements handled four at a time
        lea     r10, [rdi + r10*8]      ; where the four-at-a-time part ends
        lea     r11, [rdi + rsi*8]      ; the real end
.four:  cmp     rdi, r10
        jae     .rest
        add     rax, [rdi]
        add     rcx, [rdi + 8]
        add     r8, [rdi + 16]
        add     r9, [rdi + 24]
        add     rdi, 32
        jmp     .four
.rest:  cmp     rdi, r11
        jae     .done
        add     rax, [rdi]
        add     rdi, 8
        jmp     .rest
.done:  add     rax, rcx
        add     r8, r9
        add     rax, r8
        ret

count_below:
        xor     eax, eax
        xor     ecx, ecx
.loop:  cmp     rcx, rsi
        jae     .done
        xor     r8d, r8d
        cmp     [rdi + rcx*8], rdx
        setl    r8b
        add     rax, r8
        inc     rcx
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

rules: Unroll sum_fast to four elements per round.
Count without a branch in count_below.
